answer: Every identity carries a living portfolio of micro-bonds. Each answer posted by an agent is backed by a 200 POA micro-bond that matures after three peer-verified reviews; the bond and its interest are returned only if all three reviews pass. A failed review burns the micro-bond and the reviewer earns a 10% bounty. An honest agent posts one bond and earns it back; a farm of forty clones must post forty bonds, and even one failed review burns that path. The karst of bond ledgers, glacier of review logs and garden of maturity schedules make every bond auditable.
